extracted.intended_audience: potential donors, supporters, and the general public interested in media bias and conservative media accountability
extracted.subtask_description: An 'About' page for a single nonprofit media-watchdog organization describing its mission, programs, leadership, impact metrics, and calls to action. Meant to inform and recruit supporters/donors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission of The Media Research Center
rubrics_metrics.description: The mission of The Media Research Center is to document and combat the falsehoods and censorship of the news media, entertainment media and Big Tech in order to defend and preserve America's founding principles and Judeo-Christian values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The MRC is a research and education organization operating under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code, and contributions to the MRC are tax-deductible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational purpose / positioning
rubrics_metrics.description: The Media Research Center (MRC) exists to expose and neutralize the elitist media. The truth should not be a partisan debate. Americans deserve to know the real, unfiltered news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The MRC positions itself as the unrelenting counterforce to leftist bias in America’s newsrooms, broadcast networks, and Big Tech platforms and claims to be the receipts the media pray you never see.

rubrics_metrics.name: How we deliver the truth / approach
rubrics_metrics.description: To counter the media's leftist agenda, the MRC formed specialized divisions and programs to precisely target egregious bias with comprehensive media analysis and factual reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Through powerhouse platforms like MRC’s NewsBusters, MRC Free Speech America, and MRC Video, we hold journalists, anchors, editors, and Silicon Valley censors accountable when no one else dares.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program: Daily Media Bias Watchdog Reporting (NewsBusters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Daily Media Bias Watchdog Reporting — Visit NewsBusters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a core MRC program for monitoring and reporting media bias on a daily basis; linked for users to visit the NewsBusters platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program: Viral Video Content Exposing Left-Wing Narratives (MRC Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Viral Video Content Exposing Left-Wing Narratives — Visit MRC Video.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a program to produce and distribute video content that exposes narratives the organization characterizes as left-wing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program: Fighting Big Tech Censorship and Election Interference (MRC FSA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fighting Big Tech Censorship and Election Interference — Visit MRC FSA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a program focused on Big Tech censorship and election-related issues, with a link to MRC Free Speech America.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact metric: Total MRC video views (2024)
rubrics_metrics.description: 885.5 million — Total MRC video views in 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a claim of reach and impact for MRC's video output during 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact metric: Subscribers and Followers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to quantify the size of MRC's audience across platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact metric: Average monthly website page views
rubrics_metrics.description: 2.2 million — Average monthly website page views.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as a measure of ongoing web traffic and audience engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact metric: Hours of news programming archived
rubrics_metrics.description: 1+ million — Hours of news programming archived by MRC since 1987.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to convey the organization's archival scope and research resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact metric: Verified cases of online censorship (CensorTrack.org)
rubrics_metrics.description: 8,000+ — Verified cases of online censorship archived by MRC’s CensorTrack.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as evidence of documented censorship incidents tracked by the organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact metric: MRC Internship program graduates
rubrics_metrics.description: 540 — Graduates from the MRC Internship program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to indicate the scale and longevity of the organization's internship/education efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Founding and leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: Founded in 1987 by L. Brent Bozell III and led today by his son, David Bozell (Media Research Center President).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Framed to establish organizational history, continuity, and conservative pedigree; emphasizes nearly four decades of activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Call to action / donor appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Join our fight. Become a Watchdog today! Donate to The MRC. Subscribe to The Watchdog email with David Bozell.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple CTAs aimed at recruiting supporters, donors, and email subscribers; donation emphasized as supporting the mission.

rubrics_metrics.description: The MRC is a research and education organization operating under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Federal Tax ID Number: 54-1429009 and statement that contributions are tax-deductible; intended to inform donors of nonprofit status.
